headline: Musk v. OpenAI Verdict Clears Major IPO Obstacle; Musk Vows Ninth Circuit Appeal
raw_snippet: A jury took less than two hours to reject all of Elon Musk's claims against OpenAI, finding he missed the statute of limitations. Musk slammed the verdict as a 'technicality' and vowed to appeal. The dismissal removes a significant legal overhang that could have forced OpenAI and Microsoft to disgorge up to $150 billion. Legal analysts note the case previewed how antitrust issues will shape AI's future, even though antitrust wasn't in the complaint. The verdict clears the path for OpenAI's confidential IPO filing days later.

headline: OpenAI IPO Filing Reveals Negative 122% Operating Margin in Q1 2026 and $600B in Compute Commitments
raw_snippet: OpenAI's confidential S-1 filing reveals the company lost $1.22 for every $1 of revenue in Q1 2026 — a negative 122% non-GAAP operating margin, or roughly $6.95 billion in quarterly losses. The company is on the hook for approximately $600 billion in compute commitments over the next five years. OpenAI projects $14 billion in losses for full-year 2026 on $30 billion in revenue. CFO Sarah Friar has internally signaled the company is 'not ready' for a public listing, creating tension with CEO Altman's timeline.

headline: OpenAI Confidentially Files for IPO Amid Race with SpaceX and Anthropic for Trillion-Dollar Listings
raw_snippet: OpenAI filed its confidential draft registration statement with the SEC on May 22. Fortune notes the filing may finally answer big questions about the company's path to profitability, the structure of its nonprofit-to-PBC conversion, and governance. The IPO would be the largest technology IPO in history if OpenAI reaches its $1 trillion target valuation. Anthropic is reportedly aiming for its own IPO later in 2026, creating an unprecedented concentration of AI company listings.

headline: OpenAI and Dell Codex Deal Targets Regulated Industries Barred from Public Cloud
raw_snippet: OpenAI and Dell Technologies' multi-year Codex enterprise partnership specifically targets financial services, healthcare, and government buyers that cannot send data to public cloud environments. The deal leverages the Dell AI Data Platform and Dell AI Factory, giving Codex access to organizations' on-premises data stores. Codex use has expanded beyond code generation into agentic workflows including context-gathering, reporting, lead qualification, and feedback routing.

headline: OpenAI Math Breakthrough Verified by External Mathematicians; AI Goes Beyond Being 'Just an Assistant'
raw_snippet: External mathematicians who verified OpenAI's AI-generated proof disproving the Erdős conjecture in discrete geometry said 'AI has gone beyond being just an assistant.' The result is significant because it was achieved by a general-purpose reasoning model rather than a system specifically trained for mathematics. The proof discovered a novel connection to algebraic number theory that human mathematicians had not previously explored for this problem.

headline: ChatGPT PowerPoint Add-In Integrates with Outlook, Gmail, and SharePoint for Enterprise Slide Generation
raw_snippet: OpenAI's ChatGPT add-in for PowerPoint integrates with connected services including Gmail, Outlook, and SharePoint, enabling enterprises to generate slides from existing documents and communications. The beta is available to all tiers including Free users. OpenAI cautions that complex template, font, and chart handling may not yet be fully supported.
